message.text:
No nightly database-cleanup cron job exists. The scheduler package contains documentation and examples referencing "daily-cleanup," but it is never actually wired into the server.

Production background work runs via an s3presign ticker every 12 hours.

r03.
There is no nightly database-cleanup cron job and no scheduled time. `internal/scheduler` is a standalone library (docs/examples mention `"daily-cleanup"`) and is never constructed or registered from the server. Production background work is only the S3 presign ticker every 12 hours (`server/server.go`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`).
